ios.desc:
Bible Note Journal: An all-in-one app for Christians to record sermons and study Scripture.

In church or personal devotions, profound insights often come unexpectedly—and can slip away if not captured. Bible Note Journal helps you preserve every inspiration, replay every message, and dive deeper into spiritual truths, so you can stay focused on worship knowing your insights are saved for future reflection.

WHY CHOOSE BIBLE NOTE JOURNAL?

  - Effortless Recording: Record sermons, fellowship sharing, or personal prayer with a single tap. Never miss a valuable idea or Scripture reference again.
  - Intelligent Speech-to-Text: High-accuracy transcription turns your recordings into text you can revisit, search, and organize—so you can find essential points instantly.
  - Smart Summaries: Get concise takeaways from every sermon that help you grasp core themes and strengthen your faith foundation.
  - Built-In Bible with Instant Scripture Lookup: Browse, search, and study the complete Bible in the app. Tap any Scripture reference in a summary to see the verse in context.
  - Flashcards for Ongoing Growth: Turn sermons into study flashcards with Scripture memory prompts and key theological concepts to internalize biblical truths.
  - Journal Questions for Deeper Reflection: Receive personalized reflection prompts to help you process and apply God's Word.
  - Folders to Stay Organized: Group notes by sermon series, church, book of the Bible, or small group. A note can live in more than one folder.
  - iCloud Sync: Your notes, summaries, flashcards, journal entries, and folders sync automatically across your devices through iCloud.
  - File Upload Support: Upload existing recordings in mp3, m4a, wav, or flac format and let Bible Note Journal transcribe and analyze them.

Bible Note Journal is more than a recording app—it's your complete Bible note companion. Every note is searchable, enhanced with intelligent insights, organized your way, and synced across your devices. Your library grows with you as you capture sermons, create flashcards, and journal your spiritual journey.

PERFECT FOR

  - Church members wanting comprehensive Bible notes from sermons
  - Bible study leaders organizing teaching notes
  - Believers seeking to grow in their faith journey
  - Anyone who wants to capture and revisit spiritual insights

Preserve meaningful insights, revisit them any time, and let God's Word continuously renew and guide you. Download Bible Note Journal today!

quotes.text:
I got back into church a couple years ago and would try taking notes with Apple Notes. It was a struggle trying to type notes while focusing on the sermon. Honestly, it would have been easier to write it in a notebook but in the end I built this iOS app to solve that problem.

You can record audio during a sermon (or upload files), and it transcribes using Whisper, then generates summaries, flashcards, and reflection questions tailored to Christian content.

The backend is Spring Boot + Kotlin calling OpenAI's API. Instead of deploying the backend through one of the cloud providers directly I decided to go with Railway. Users are notified with push notifications when their transcription and summary are completed. The iOS app uses SwiftUI and out-of-the-box SwiftUI components.

I worked with Spring Boot + Java a few years back when in fintech so it was cool to try writing something in Kotlin. I'm also a full-time Flutter dev that has been trying to get into Native iOS development and felt like I found a good use case for an app.

Currently only available in the US/Canada App Store. There is a free 3-day trial that you can use to give the app a go.

The goal was helping Christians retain more from sermons and build stronger biblical literacy.

Happy to answer questions about the architecture, AI prompting approach for Christian content, or anything else.

App Store link: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/bible-note-journal/id6752273302
